concerns.text: All tasks are tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but many have explicit data‑flow dependencies (e.g., T002 needs contracts created in T001, T003 needs the dataset from T002, T004 needs graphs from T003, etc.). The `[P]` tag is therefore inaccurate and violates the parallel‑safety rule.

Task T004 builds composition‑only graphs using an `element_fraction` node feature, which is not part of FR‑002 until it is added by the spec‑amendment task T012. The producer (spec amendment) must precede the consumer (graph builder) to keep the task order consistent with the specification.
